fields.description: Product as listed and sold on the merchant's site at time of purchase, including specifications, materials, dimensions, and condition. The item delivered matched this listing in all material respects.

args.narrative: Merchant disputes this 4853 (goods not as described/defective) chargeback. The product delivered to the cardholder matched the product description and listing in all material respects, as documented in the product description (ev-02118fc890d0e2d2) and the cardholder's acceptance of the merchant's terms (ev-9572a9d0bf8b67da). The transaction was properly authorized (auth code 756129, ev-7cbfdfce2242c9ad) and captured for $92.32 (receipt ev-b069d80252f7ff9b). There is no evidence the item was defective or materially different from its description. The cardholder's claim is not supported by the record. Merchant requests the chargeback be reversed.
